items.headline: $DOGE Drama: Foundation Ends House of Doge Deal
items.summary: The Dogecoin Foundation and House of Doge ended their exclusive brand deal, with a separate swap of Such App assets for $4M in Dogecoin Labs stock. Big shakeup for the $DOGE ecosystem.

items.headline: SkyAI Dumps $SOL Treasury, Launches $201M Buyback
items.summary: SkyAI sold its entire Solana treasury and announced a massive $201 million cash tender offer. One of the biggest treasury exits by an onchain AI project this year.

items.headline: Canton Coin Burns as Network Logs $155M Q3 Fees
items.summary: Canton Network recorded over $155 million in Q3 fees per CertiK, with $CC burned to pay for network services. Institutional chain activity keeps climbing.

items.headline: $XPL Gets Native USDC, EURC and CCTP From Circle
items.summary: Circle added native USDC and EURC issuance plus CCTP cross-chain transfers to Plasma. A major liquidity boost for the $XPL ecosystem.

items.headline: Korean Super-App Toss Picks $OP Stack for Won Pilot
items.summary: Toss will run a Korean won stablecoin pilot on the OP Stack, becoming the fourth regulated institution in a year to build on Optimism's stack. Big win for $OP adoption in Asia.
